description: Gemini generateContent with text and an inline PNG, traced by OpenLLMetry.
notes: opentelemetry-instrumentation-google-generativeai 0.62.4 wraps google.genai.models, not the legacy google-generativeai package. TRACELOOP_TRACE_CONTENT is true, which is also the default, so message content is recorded on the span. TRACELOOP_METRICS_ENABLED is false. These provider packages have no TRACELOOP_TELEMETRY switch and no vendor export URL; spans go through the harness tracer provider. gen_ai.prompt.N is not written. The image is a 64x64 PNG generated in the program. The text part's content is the Part object's field dump, including text='Describe this square.'. The default upload hook does not return a URL, so the image stays a blob part. Usage copies prompt_token_count 90 and cached_content_token_count 40. prices.json has no Gemini model row.
